notes.title: Upcoming Update v.1.1.0 & Update v1.0.9
notes.content:
[u][b]Update V.1.0.9.5 [/b][/u]

[b]Changes :[/b]

 - Added a [u]Vive/Valve Test Mode[/u] ( Still Work in Progress )
 > Valve should work now and give the proper height or approximatively, the visual controls are gonna be wrong. (For Instance X will be L-A)
   I will try to remap every Vive and Valve controls once selected and change the visuals on the next Update. (So, I will keep calling them incompatible for now until it's done and 100% operational)
   If any Valve users have the game and want to test the game, that'd be amazing to give me feedbacks. (Send me an email : thefoxark@gmail.com, discord : Sebby#9639 or by twitter @Fox_Sebby)
  (I have an Oculus, which mean, I can't actually test anything)

 - Added a [u][b]new Function[/b][/u]
 Language now follow through levels
 > The player choose its language from the Main Screen and it will stay saved until the game is restarted or until you go back to the Game Menu.

 -[b] Added a [u]Graphic Tab[/u] in the Watch UI(French/English/Spanish)[/b]
 > [u][i]Huge for optimization and performance.[/i][/u] ( Now allows pretty much all the computers to play the game )
 3D Resolution / View Distance / Shadow Quality / Effects Quality

Portuguese Language support will be added in the Next Update

Note that we are still working on the Patch 1.1.0 -> Details are down below



[u][b]Update V.1.0.9 [/b][/u]

[b]Changes :[/b]

 - Added Header-HUD Subtitles (French/English/Spanish)
 - Added PlayZone FootPrints (To Show the Playzone middle / Sync with HUD and Player Capsule / Staying on those footprints will get the collision right)
[u] - Optimization : Game Menu and Level 1 (Average frames should be better by 25%)[/u]
 - Last Puzzle in Level 2 Final Fix (100% working now)



Hello fellow [b]gamers[/b]!

We heard some of your concerns about the optimization of the game for non-High-End Computers.

We currently have some [u]FPS Boost[/u] buttons in all 3 levels but we will make them more performant in the next patch and focus a lot on people frames.

[u][b]Upcoming V.1.1.0 [/b][/u]
[b]Features : 
[/b]
- [b]Level 4 [/b](This level is gonna be completely different than the others, it will be more like an "Escape Room" than the previous ones which are focused on Puzzles and Riddles) Spoiler :  We are making a massive mansion.
Our objective is to add a story line, and make things way more interesting. We are trying to outpass ourselves on this one! That level by itself might be as long as the 3 past others combined, it is gonna literally a new game in the current game but, we are still following our TimeLine progression.
> Plus, we are gonna make 3 graphics options for all kind of computers. AND we are using a new method to build the map, it will be a lot more optimized than the previous ones, even on High Graphics. (To Do)

- [b]Multilanguage Subtitles System with the HUD[/b] - French / English / Spanish (Added in v1.0.9)

- [b]Footprints[/b]. Those footprints have for purpose to show the middle of your PlayZone for the best collision. 
It will show up at the same time as your Header-HUD and be almost invisible after 15 seconds so it's not bothering your view. (Added in v1.0.9) 

- [b]Saving system[/b], we expect the 4th level to be at least 4-5 hours long! It will be literally a full game. We know that not everyone has that much time. Which is why we are gonna implement a proper Saving/Loading system from the Game Menu. (To Do)

- [b]Another language[/b] will be added (Portuguese) (To Do)

- [b]Previous levels optimization (1-2-3)[/b], we are going to improve the FPS Boost button and optimize the game on its best graphics too in order to improve the average Frames per second. (Added in v1.0.9)

- [b]Vive compatibility Support![/b] (To Do)

Some of those features may vary, they are projections of what we want to provide.

Update Release Date : January, 2021

Follow Us on Twitter to stay updated!

-Fox_Sebby Production

notes.title: Update v.1.0.8 & Upcoming
notes.content:
[b]v1.0.8[/b]

[b]Major Changes :[/b]

[u]Added a Multi-Functional Header[/u] [b]HUD[/b]
[u][b]*Features*[/b][/u]
 > You can toggle it ON/OFF (With the Joysticks - both at the same time)
 > It tells you when is the next hint (It tracks your progression, so you don't receive unnecessary hints)
 > Your progression through the level (It tracks how far are you from the end of the level)
 > Tell your time played during the level (Your hands have the same timer)
 > Multilanguages (French/English/Spanish)

- Changed the whole Level 3 puzzle route to make it compatible with the new Progression System

[b]Minor Changes :[/b]

- Added a new Test Hint System in the Level 3
- Added a new Hint in Level 3 to make it easier to understand what you have to do
- Fixed a problem where some textures were not loading in the tutorial (Spanish)
- Fixed the last puzzle in the Level 2 (3rd attempt is the charm)
- Fixed Few more Translations (Level 1 & 3)

[u][b]Upcoming in v1.0.9[/b][/u]
 -Fully Functional Subtitles system that works with the Header HUD and different languages
 -Bug fix reported by users (If you find a bug, or see something wrong, please mention it in the discussion section so I can take care of it)
 
I will try to make a big update once every months to provide new content such as a level, new features and fix all the bugs reported!

Note : I will fix any major bugs reported ASAP

[b][u]
KEEP IN MIND THAT THIS PROJECT IS AN INDIE GAME MADE BY ONE INDEPENDANT PERSON[/u][/b]


[b]v1.0.7[/b]

[b]Major Change :[/b]
- Full Translation in Spanish[u] (UI/Voicing/Writing)[/u]

[b]Minor changes :[/b]
- New Line in Level 1(French/English/Spanish to give a small hint)
- Removed the Cheesy Part in Level 2 (English)
- Fixed Some Translations
- Fixed Few Minor Bugs (Visual)

[b]Upcoming after Launch (Plans) :[/b]

[b]Promises :[/b]
- Saving System (Will try to make it on the same patch as the Level 4 because it will be needed)
- Level 4 & More (I plan on expanding the game as much as I can to provide the best experience and fresh content)
- Vive Support (Hard because the controls are different - Will probably be a complete different client or such)
- Pop up Subtitles with Narrations that works with different languages and follow camera (Not a priority but cool feature)

I want the level 4 and probably the next ones to feel like a complete different game, each of them. 
Still an escape room but (Longer, bigger, better graphics, more thrills, adventure feels and more features)

Things I hope and will do everything I can to make happen [u](But I can't promise)[/u] :
- Multiplayer System (Would give a much better experience for the level 4+)
- More full languages support! (Was thinking about Russian, German & Chinese)

-Fixed Multiple Visual Glitches (Level 1 / 2 / 3)
-Fixed Multiple Small Mistakes (Level 1 / 2 / 3)
-Translation Errors (Level 1)
